tools.name: sml_discover
tools.description: Find the x402 Gateway contract and where to inspect fresh payment requirements. FREE.

tools.name: sml_status
tools.description: Check the public x402 Gateway identity and canonical payment rail. FREE.

tools.name: x402_contract
tools.description: Inspect the canonical x402 payment contract. Returns network, USDC asset, payTo, headers, and the rule for resolving fresh target requirements. FREE.

tools.name: interfere
tools.description: Coherent Gate (PAID, x402/USDC). Scores whether your trading-signal paths agree: confidence-weighted long/short/flat consensus, coherence 0-1, and a pass/block gate (pass needs a non-flat consensus and coherence at or above the threshold, default 0.6). Tiers by path count: scout ≤4 $0.01, standard ≤

tools.name: leviathan_interfere
tools.description: Coherent Gate + Leviathan (PAID, x402/USDC). Fetches the SML Leviathan signal (squeeze, momentum, or all) for a ticker, adds it as one path with your optional paths and registered sources, then runs the same coherence check as interfere: consensus, coherence 0-1, pass/block gate. Same tiers and bill

tools.name: spend_gate_check
tools.description: Spend Gate (PAID $0.005 USDC on Base via x402). Ask Jev before you spend: checks whether an agent wallet should pay a payee a quoted USDC amount.
